question: What optimum conditions did response surface methodology find, and what decolorization efficiency was predicted and then measured?
expect: pH 5.94, 68.07 mg/L dye, 0.71 g monolith; predicted 98.14%, validated 96.43% (abstract)
rendered: Response surface methodology identified optimum conditions at pH 5.94, an initial dye concentration of 68.07 mg L−1, and a monolith dosage of 0.71 g. Under these conditions, the predicted decolorization efficiency of 98.14% agreed closely with the experimentally validated value of 96.43%.
